text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed prefetch/prefix cache hit-rate dropped ~15% on prod since 03:00 UTC. Any dashboards I should check? :eyes:
ashwin: Which alert or panel did you see this on? can you paste the grafana link or alert id?
maria: Saw a spike in tail latency, then noticed the hit-rate dip in our ops dash. snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abcd/prefix-cache?from=now-6h&to=now
ashwin: That dashboard lives under 'kv-prefetch' -> 'prefix hit-rate (per-route)'. try filtering by route=/embedder and node.
infra-bot: Alert fired: PREFIX_CACHE_HITRATE_DROP (severity: p3) — drop >5% over 15m. Details: https://alerts.redwood.company/alerts/112233
sofia: FYI I'm on alert rotation this week. Happy to tune if it's noisy. Do you have a repro query or prefix example?
liam: Also check eviction counts — `kvcache_evictions_total` spiking would explain cold misses.
nashwin: Quick PromQL to slice by prefix:
```promql
sum(rate(kvcache_prefix_hits_total{job="inference",env="prod"}[5m])) by (prefix)
/
sum(rate(kvcache_prefix_lookups_total{job="inference",env="prod"}[5m])) by (prefix)
```
maria: Running that now. looks like prefix="seq-102" dropped to ~18% hit-rate, others stable.
sofia: If it's single-prefix that's probably a prefetch regression or model change (larger KV footprint). Run per-node heatmap: `kvcache_hit_ratio{node=~".*"}` to spot node-local problems.
nashwin: For alert tuning suggestion: widen window to 30m and require min_affected_prefixes > 5 to avoid single-prefix flaps. Also add an annotation that points to latest deploys.
maria: Can someone open a tiny PR to change the alert expr + add runbook link? prefer to assign to @sofia unless you're overloaded.
sofia: I'll take it. pinging @liam for logs/traces access to confirm evictions correlate.
liam: grabbing traces now, will paste samples. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks — also please add the prefetched/prefix dashboard link to /docs/ops/cache for easier triage.
sofia: Done: PR #489 adds dashboard link + runbook section. I'll set a 48h canary after merge.
nashwin: Noted, will monitor graphs and ETA 6h for initial recovery window. cc @infra-bot for post-merge checks.
infra-bot: Deployment detected: runbook update merged to main. Will notify if regressions occur.
maria: Closing loop for now — will re-open if hit-rate doesn't improve in 6h. Thanks all. :relieved:
